checkedAlternates.risk: A fuse is a passive two-terminal element.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A fuse is specifically a sacrificial overcurrent protection device (group-1), not a resistor.

checkedAlternates.risk: Thermistors are often made from semiconductor oxides.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Thermistors function as temperature-dependent resistors (group-4), not diodes or transistors.
